positions.name: MissingIdTestSpecification
positions.frame: what does the missing-id-derivation test case have to establish for it to count as valid production-failure coverage?
positions.why: src-1 asserts what the test reproduces (the prod missing-id pattern: ## heading, no id field) and src-2 states the correctness bar the reproduction must clear (no crash, valid slug). Both are flat, calm, technical-register statements about the same single test case — one names the setup, the other the pass/fail condition — read together they describe one test's completeness, not two separate claims. No tension: the conviction reads differ (src-1 an unsettled claim, src-2 a settled operational rule) but both point at the same artifact from complementary angles.
